name: Manya Krobo Rural Bank
description: Full website for Manya Krobo Rural Bank PLC, rebuilt from a UI/UX audit of the live site. Covers every account, loan and insurance product on one product template, a branch finder with open-now status, loan and susu calculators, an online account-opening flow, investor relations with dated AGM notices and sized report downloads, news, gallery with a lightbox, complaints, security and legal pages. All bank facts live in _build/bank.mjs, and ?review=1 highlights every figure still to confirm.
